propositions: Under rich_text_cutover="cloud", the outbound comment differ computes local and Jira-side dedup keys using different decode compositions, causing markdown-escaped characters to diverge between the two sides

The local key applies a markdown round trip (escape + rewrite autolinks) via AdfCodec.normalize_outbound, while the Jira-side key applies adf_to_text (no escaping), causing identical landed comments to be re-emitted as duplicates

The send path encodes a decorated comment body, and markdown_to_adf's content-preservation fallback degrades HTML comments to plain text, but the local key derives from the undecorated body, creating an asymmetry in the landed wire representation
The fix derives both dedup keys by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it through the single _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side

Verification shows the new one-decoder approach produces matching keys across all cutover settings and comment types (in-limit markdown, over-length, plain text) while maintaining backward compatibility where old keys already matched
